_README: Categories: primary (a position body) | addon (a modifier body) | instruction (stripped, never emitted)
| letter_shell (document frame) | blocked (deferred: R0/R1 rent schedules, LCW primaries) | empty.
The completeness harness asserts every non-empty paragraph carries a category, that every
'primary' and 'addon' paragraph maps to a loaded canonical body, and that NO paragraph is
'unassigned'. Re-run against any future template drop: new or moved paragraphs surface as
unassigned and fail the harness, which is also the template-transition detector.

_patch_history.note: Merged, not replaced. text_head and template_paragraphs untouched (transition detector stays byte-exact).

_unjoined_bodies._note: Loaded canonical bodies claimed by NO paragraph in ANY skeleton. LIBRARY-WIDE registry — declared here, in the letter manifest, and nowhere else. kind='permanent' is correct forever; kind='pending' is expected to leave once its source lands, and is printed on every run so it cannot rot unnoticed.
